mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.company_id, u.department_id, d.dept_name AS department_name, u.login_id, u.email, u.name, u.role, u.phone_number, u.is_active, u.last_login_at, u.created_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id, u.company_id, u.department_id, d.dept_name AS department_name, u.login_id, u.email, u.name, u.role, u.phone_number, u.is_active, u.last_login_at, u.created_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (company_id, department_id, login_id, email, name, role, phone_number, password_hash, is_active) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{departmentId}, #{loginId}, #{email}, #{name}, #{role}::user_role_enum, #{phoneNumber}, #{passwordHash}, true)
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.dept_name, f.facility_name FROM departments d JOIN company_facilities f ON d.facility_id = f.id ORDER BY f.facility_name, d.dept_name
